issues.title: Deploy failed on Friday
issues.body: GitHub Actions minutes exhausted. Deploy failed again at the end of the week.

issues.title: CI quota exhausted again
issues.body: Deploys failing on Friday because the runner quota is used up. Recurring problem.

issues.title: Migrate backend from Firebase to Supabase
issues.body: Migrating auth, events and registrations tables to Supabase Postgres. Firebase free tier quota broke during registrations.

issues.title: Friday deploy failure
issues.body: Same as #97 and #103, CI runner quota exhausted on Friday. Deploy failed.

issues.title: Event card layout broken on mobile
issues.body: Event cards overflow on small screens. Good first issue.

issues.title: Switch login to college SSO
issues.body: Replaces email magic links with college SSO. The SSO certificate expires on 14 March 2027 and must be renewed by the IT cell.

issues.title: Webhook has no retry handling
issues.body: Razorpay may resend webhooks. Without idempotency we could create duplicate registrations and double charge. Blocked until someone owns the payments module.

issues.title: Payment refunds
issues.body: Adds refund flow for cancelled registrations. Test test_refund_partial is failing.

issues.title: Email reminders instead of OneSignal
issues.body: Switching to email-only reminders because OneSignal is too expensive.

issues.title: Migration 0009 only applied on staging
issues.body: Migration 0009 (registration status column) runs on staging. Production not migrated yet. Need to apply before fest.

commit.message: payments: integrate Razorpay checkout with UPI
checkin: QR code generation for tickets
ui: event cards and schedule page
